scoring_justification: The main artifact is final texture fractions; recomputing from raw orientation maps is not feasible. Using hidden thresholds derived from the paper's qualitative trends.

outputs.description: Time series of texture component fractions for each film thickness and Monte Carlo step.
Final texture component fractions for the 100 nm, 500 nm, and 800 nm films.

output_contract.notes: The checker reads both artifacts and applies threshold checks on the final fractions (e.g., {111} dominance in 100 nm films, {001} dominance in 800 nm films, appearance of {511} twin component in 500 nm films). The CSV is used to verify simulation length (MCS > 1000) and fractions-sum sanity. All scoring uses tolerance margins appropriate for stochastic simulation spread.

steps.description: Verifies the CSV contains at least 1000 MCS final steps, and that the sum of fractions per thickness lies in [0.9,1.1].

Checks final texture fractions meet qualitative trend thresholds: {111}>0.4 for 100nm, {001}>0.4 for 800nm, and {511}>0.1 & {111}>0.1 for 500nm. Also verifies sum of fractions in [0.9,1.1] for each thickness.
